# Engine features

Edit the resource document or Godot text scene, then run. The top cyan square uses AnimationPlayer. The two colored squares use SpriteFrames and an imported TSCN. The strip uses TileMapLayer. GridMap and 2D/3D navigation are checked through runtime stats.
